## Disclosure checks (required)

- [ ] Nothing in this contribution is confidential, embargoed, or pre-release. I
      have confirmed every product, feature, version, date, and customer name in
      it is already public or cleared for announcement.
- [ ] Any partner, customer, or third-party organization named here has agreed to
      the mention.
- [ ] Any screenshots, diagrams, logos, or images are cleared for public use.
- [ ] No credentials, internal hostnames, internal URLs, or personal data appear
      anywhere in the diff, including in example commands and output.

## Licensing (required)

- [ ] I have signed off every commit (`git commit -s`). See
      [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I have the right to submit this work under
      [CC-BY-4.0](../LICENSE), and I understand I keep the copyright in it.
- [ ] Any third-party material I quote or adapt is attributed inline and its
      license permits this use.
- [ ] This pull request adds **no** third-party dependency, theme, vendored code,
      or package manifest. *(If it does, say so explicitly below — it requires
      re-opening the repository's OSRB approval and updating
      [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) before merge.)*

## Quality

- [ ] Links resolve, and version numbers and commands are accurate as written.
- [ ] Commands and prerequisites were actually run, not written from memory.
- [ ] Spelling and terminology follow NVIDIA usage.
